summary: A marina’s local name reaches one federal listing while other agencies still use the old channel name.
realLife: The Coast Guard used Deering Bay Channel while NOAA charts still labeled the channel Cutler. After the vote the Florida register listed Deering Bay Channel as official, and the national names file retained Cutler Channel as a variant under feature 1989332.
inGame: needs: the local usage, each agency’s dated listing and the federal decision.
